item.title: Welsh heritage railway hosting an open day for new volunteers
item.description: Llangollen and Corwen Railway is inviting the community behind the scenes this spring as it hosts a special Volunteer Open Day.

item.title: Passengers warned to plan ahead of travel between Leeds and Huddersfield this May and June
item.description: Network Rail is warning passengers of major disruptions to service on the line between Huddersfield and Leeds this May and June, due to engineering work involving the Transpennine Route Upgrade (TRU).

item.title: Accredited Museum status for Suffolk Railway
item.description: The Mid Suffolk Light Railway recently applied to regain its Accredited Museum status.

item.title: New LMS 3F Jinty Sound Pack announced
item.description: A new sound pack has been released by Steam Sounds Supreme for Dovetail's Train Simulator.

item.title: Manchester Piccadilly sees first train following upgrades
item.description: Track panels being dropped during Piccadilly upgrades February 2026

item.title: Historic Great Eastern Railway coach arrives at the Mid-Suffolk Light Railway
item.description: The Mid-Suffolk Light Railway has announced the arrival of the historic former Great Eastern Railway Coach No. 14, secured thanks to the support and dedication of its members.

item.title: Greater Anglia announces 20 additional contactless ticket stations from 8 March
item.description: Greater Anglia have announced that from Sunday, 8 March 2026, passengers will be able to enjoy pay-as-you-go contactless ticketing at an additional 20 stations along the line, making travel quicker, simpler, and more flexible.

item.title: Portsmouth Direct Line half term work completed
item.description: Following the completion of maintenance work over 9 days between Petersfield and Havant, services have now resumed.

item.title: Farewell tour for mark III trains raises £20,000 for charity
item.description: A farewell rail tour celebrating the iconic Chiltern Railways' Mark 3 fleet has raised £20,000 for charity, marking the end of an era for trains that have been in service since the 1970s.

item.title: Trans India Rail to offer freight train charter this May
item.description: Trans India Rail, which has operated the Cinderella Hotel for over 25 years, has been running a Photo Freight Charter on the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway since 2018. After extensive lobbying with railway authorities, the company has curated a unique package for rail enthusiasts to enjoy, combining photography with an evening steam dining train and workshop tours.
